Consent Form

 

 

Introduction

In this study, the Digital Society Initiative of the University of Zurich is researching the perceptions and experiences of digital news readers. We greatly value your participation in our research and want to ensure you that you cannot do anything wrong and there are no right or wrong answers.

 

Scope and Procedure
If you decide to take part in this study, the following activities take place:


	You will participate in a online survey.
	The survey will take approximately 20 minutes to complete.
	You will interact with an AI based Propaganda Bot, which will discuss the propaganda given in a article with you.There is the possibility that the Propaganda Bot, instead of discussing the propaganda of the given article, just confirms the viewpoints of the presented article. Thus, there is the possibility that you are deceived during the experiment.





The following information will be collected during the study:  


	Basic demographic information.
	Your anonymous responses to questions about your understanding and interpretation of the news articles.
	Your evaluation of the performance of a propaganda detection tool developed by us.
	Your interaction with the AI based Propaganda Bot, please note we solely collect transcripts, and the timing of your answers. No Voice data of any participant is collected.


 

Risks Associated with Participation
Participation in the study does not involve any considerable risks that we are aware of. However, we would like to note that the study involves reading news articles about contemporary topics that can potentially cause emotional reactions. Please be aware that during this study, you may be exposed to articles that might contain misinformation or propaganda. These materials are used specifically for research purposes. We kindly request that you do not share, reproduce, or distribute any content, including articles, images, or other media, that you come across during your participation in this study. This restriction is crucial to ensure that potentially misleading or incorrect information is not propagated outside of the research context.



You have the option to end your participation at any time during the study without having to provide a reason. All information you have shared with us up to this point may be stored and used for research.



This experiment has been approved by the Ethics Committee of the University of Zurich.

 
Consent
By signing this form, you acknowledge the following statements:


You permit your anonymized data to be used by other researchers of the University of Zurich and the University of Lausanne for further studies and analyses.
You authorize the use of your anonymized data for internal or external publications, as well as scientific journals and conference proceedings.
	You have been informed about the purpose and conditions of your study participation.
	You are at least 18 years old.
	You had enough time to decide to participate.
	You agree to participate.



Giving consent to this form in no way waives your legal rights or releases the researchers or institutions involved from their legal or professional responsibilities. You are free to withdraw from the study at any time.



If you have any further questions about your participation in this study at a later point in time, please contact Kilian Sprenkamp (kilian.sprenkamp@uzh.ch).
